## Byte-equivalence (SHA-256)

The 2026-03-17 Mode-A run produced three clusters of result files that are
byte-identical despite distinct filenames. The clusters are documented here
rather than deduplicated so the experimental-condition provenance
(filename → run condition) is preserved. The cross-check confirms
`results/FULL_RUN_REPORT.md` does not describe any byte-equivalent pair as
a distinct experimental condition; identical filenames map to identical
runs.

| SHA-256 | Files | Why identical |
|---|---|---|
| `1ce96da0a879f519522505f45aafd10ef2b97192194a7734907bbd12e2a511f2` | `results/baselines_distractor_catrandom.json` ≡ `results/baselines_k4.json` | The distractor-comparison Mode-A run with `distractor_strategy=category_random` is the same run as the `K=4` baseline run, since `K=4` is the default and `category_random` was the default distractor at the time of the run. Both filenames refer to the same experiment from different naming axes. |
| `fb7a0fef1783ebf48adb6ecac2bd91bd5b072490aec6e9e843bd6a9dbd4f00c5` | `results/baselines_distractor_sbert.json` ≡ `results/baselines_tfidf.json` ≡ `results/baselines_seqbayes.json` | Three baselines that, on Mode-A's evaluation slice, share the identical accuracy / S_q / reward metrics down to byte-level JSON serialization. Worth flagging as a possible deeper signal in the eval pipeline (see Residual Concerns in the COMMIT-PLAN review). |
| `216247991796293b82e785ce6b31d2010fee1aaebcf62276e53797d5a4e12d4a` | `results/eval_ew_logistic.json` ≡ `results/eval_expected_wins_empirical.json` | The Expected-Wins evaluation has two equivalent surfacings (logistic estimator vs empirical estimator) that on Mode-A produce byte-identical outputs. |

## External archives

These files are not tracked in git but were produced by this run. Archive
externally (Dropbox, lab share, S3, etc.) and reference here for
discoverability.

| File | Size | SHA-256 | Reason for external archival |
|---|---:|---|---|
| `results/phase_8_sweep.txt` | 4,801,854 bytes (4.6 MB) | `7882f31cac2aefe3c170b98a46122136384c439a89e7e14042758595c8c91db0` | UTF-16-LE CRLF stdout dump; GitHub will not render or diff it usefully and `git grep`/`git blame` are not useful. Gitignored in the same commit that adds `.cleanup-assessment/` to `.gitignore`. |
